title: Neurosurgical Implants Marking and Packaging of Implantable Neural Stimulators
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14921) covers Neurosurgical Implants Marking and Packaging of Implantable Neural Stimulators. This Indian Standard which is identical with IS0 1 031 : 1 995 'Neurosurgical implants — Marking and packaging of implantable neural stimulators 1 issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Neurosurgery Instruments Sectional Committee and approval of the Medical Equipment and Hospital Planning Division Council. The objective of this standard is to ensure that the neural stimulator (including implant pulse generators and implant radio frequency receivers) or component thereof is adequately packaged and that the device and packaging are labelled with sufficient information. This information needs to be readily available to the clinician and patient so as to facilitate decision-making on such matters as the choice of device, the methods of implantation, adjustment and fault diagnosis, and convey user precautions. It is recommended that implantable neural stimulators and components are manufactured in accordance with the ISO 9000 series of Quality
clause_3_terminology: Neurosurgical Implants Marking and Packaging of Implantable Neural Stimulators

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
